data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Canonical serializer must constrain payload and provenance shape. (a) Declare Mutation.payload and Mutation.provenance as dict[str, JSON-scalar] only — no sets, datetimes, custom objects. (b) Add __post_init__ check in Mutation (task-1) rejecting non-conformant values. (c) Add test test_serialize_manifest_rejects_non_canonical_payload covering set/datetime/custom-object rejection. (d) If datetime values are needed, mandate ISO-8601 string serialization at Mutation construction, not at serialize_manifest time. Rationale: dd-1 and dd-3 depend on canonical serialization of every field — unspecified payload shape is the most likely source of flaky hash tests (implicit_assumption).
